requirements.statement: When the caller invokes LL_CRC_Write_IDR on a valid CRC peripheral instance with a 32-bit data value, the CRC LL driver shall write the supplied 32-bit value to CRC_IDR.IDR.
requirements.verification: A host unit test invokes LL_CRC_Write_IDR with the 32-bit pattern 0xDEADBEEF on a valid CRC instance; the test passes when the CRC_IDR.IDR register array contains 0xDEADBEEF after the call.

requirements.statement: When the caller invokes LL_CRC_Read_IDR on a valid CRC peripheral instance, the CRC LL driver shall return the current 32-bit value of CRC_IDR.IDR.
requirements.verification: A host unit test writes the 32-bit pattern 0x12345678 into the CRC_IDR.IDR register array, then invokes LL_CRC_Read_IDR on the valid CRC instance; the test passes when the returned value equals the pattern stored in the CRC_IDR.IDR register array.
